name: a-failed-rules-run-that-named-nothing-is-not-a-pass
find:
return failing or [f"pytest exited {done.returncode} and named no test, so "
                       "nothing here can say which rule moved; run it yourself: "
                       f"pytest {DEADLINE_RULES.name}"]
breaks: a run of the deadline rules that failed to collect at all reports as no rules failing, so a re-measure that could not judge the deadline reads exactly like one that judged it and found it fine (#1351, L98)
